main.title: Raspberry Pi
main.summary: Raspberry Pi is a family of small single-board computers developed in Britain to help teach computer science.

cards.heading: Raspberry Pi
cards.text:
Raspberry Pi is a family of small single-board computers developed in Britain by the Raspberry Pi Foundation with Broadcom. Created to help teach computer science in schools, the machines also found uses in robotics, home automation, industry and hobby projects through their compact size and low cost. A commercial company, now Raspberry Pi Holdings, was established to support demand.

The range extends from microcontrollers to computers intended for everyday PC use. Models offer connections such as HDMI, USB and GPIO pins, with wireless networking and memory capacities varying across the range. Storage is typically provided through microSD cards.

main.title: Ultra-high-definition television
main.summary: Ultra-high-definition television (also known as Ultra HD television, Ultra HDTV, Ultra HD, UHDTV, UHD and Super Hi-Vision) today includes 4K UHD and 8K UHD, which are two digital video formats with an aspect ratio of 16:9.

cards.heading: Ultra-high-definition television
cards.text:
Ultra-high-definition television (also known as Ultra HD television, Ultra HDTV, Ultra HD, UHDTV, UHD and Super Hi-Vision) today includes 4K UHD and 8K UHD, which are two digital video formats with an aspect ratio of 16:9. These were first proposed by NHK Science & Technology Research Laboratories and later defined and approved by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).

The Consumer Electronics Association announced on October 17, 2012, that "Ultra High Definition", or "Ultra HD", would be used for displays that have an aspect ratio of 16:9 or wider and at least one digital input capable of carrying and presenting native video at a minimum resolution of 3840 × 2160. In 2015, the Ultra HD Forum was created to bring together the end-to-end video production ecosystem to ensure interoperability and produce industry guidelines so that adoption of ultra-high-definition television could accelerate. From just 30 in Q3 2015, the forum published a list of up to 55 commercial services available around the world offering 4K resolution.

main.title: The Avengers
main.subtitle: Marvel brings its separate heroes into one uneasy team
main.summary: The Avengers brings Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye together against Loki. Nick Fury assembles the team through S.H.I.E.L.D., but the recruits have competing habits and loyalties. Directed by Joss Whedon, the Marvel Studios film began its international release on 25 April 2012 and reached United States cinemas on 4 May.

cards.heading: A team assembled across films
cards.text: The Avengers brings Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye together against Loki. Nick Fury assembles the team through S.H.I.E.L.D., but the recruits have competing habits and loyalties. Directed by Joss Whedon, the Marvel Studios film began its international release on 25 April 2012 and reached United States cinemas on 4 May.

cards.heading: Personalities before cooperation
cards.text: The earlier films give the meeting a particular energy. Tony Stark treats authority as an invitation to argue; Steve Rogers approaches the crisis through duty; Thor has a family connection to the enemy. Bruce Banner must decide how much control he can trust himself to keep. Their first exchanges give cooperation a cost. The action becomes easier to follow because each hero brings a recognisable way of responding to danger.

cards.heading: A shared screen
cards.text: The New York battle turns those differences into a working arrangement. Characters cover separate parts of the city, pass threats between them and combine abilities that their individual stories had established. A long moving shot links several fights into one continuous view of the team. The film gave Marvel's shared continuity a clear dramatic payoff: viewers could carry their knowledge of earlier adventures into a new story built around the meeting itself.

main.title: London 2012 Olympic Games
main.summary: London hosted the Olympic Games from 27 July to 12 August 2012, welcoming 10,518 athletes from 206 National Olympic Committees.

cards.heading: London 2012 Olympic Games
cards.text: London hosted the Olympic Games from 27 July to 12 August 2012, welcoming 10,518 athletes from 206 National Olympic Committees. It became the first city to stage the modern Games three times, following 1908 and 1948. Preparations transformed a former industrial site in Stratford into a 200-hectare Olympic Park, with sustainability central to the redevelopment plans. Existing venues also hosted competitions, and some events took place elsewhere in Britain. The Games connected a major sporting gathering with extensive changes to a part of East London.

main.title: Oculus Rift launches on Kickstarter
main.summary: Oculus opened its Rift developer-kit crowdfunding campaign on August 1, 2012, attracting 9,522 backers.

cards.heading: A developer kit finds its backers
cards.text:
Oculus launched its Rift developer-kit campaign on Kickstarter on August 1, 2012. The project raised US$2,437,429 from 9,522 backers against a US$250,000 goal, bringing substantial support to Palmer Luckey's virtual-reality headset project.

The first development kit, DK1, shipped in March 2013, followed by DK2 in 2014. These early models gave developers a platform on which to build VR software and enthusiasts a chance to try the technology before the consumer Rift CV1. The headset line continued through the Rift S, discontinued in April 2021.

main.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
main.subtitle: Bilbo leaves the Shire with thirteen dwarves
main.summary: Bilbo Baggins has a comfortable home and little reason to leave it until Gandalf arrives with thirteen dwarves. Their leader, Thorin Oakenshield, wants to recover Erebor, the kingdom taken by the dragon Smaug. Peter Jackson cast Martin Freeman as the reluctant recruit whose small size and inexperience make him an unlikely companion. The journey soon carries him through encounters with trolls, goblins and Gollum. In the riddle game beneath the mountains, Bilbo finds the ring that will connect this earlier adventure to The Lord of the Rings.

cards.heading: A burglar leaves Bag End

cards.heading: A familiar world at a different speed
cards.text: An Unexpected Journey premiered in Wellington on 28 November 2012, returning Jackson's production team to the New Zealand landscapes and workshops used for Middle-earth. The screenplay was credited to Fran Walsh, Philippa Boyens, Jackson and Guillermo del Toro. The film was shot in stereoscopic 3D at 48 frames per second and shown in several formats, including high frame rate presentations. Weta Digital also revisited Gollum with improved facial capture. Beside those technical changes, the conversation between Bilbo and Gollum gives the effects a clear dramatic task: carrying suspicion, calculation and fear across their faces.

main.title: House of Cards
main.subtitle: Frank and Claire Underwood build a route through Washington
main.summary: The 2013 American House of Cards relocates an earlier British political drama to Washington. Kevin Spacey and Robin Wright play Frank and Claire Underwood, whose ambitions turn their marriage into a working political partnership. Developed by Beau Willimon, with David Fincher directing the opening episodes, its entire thirteen-episode first season arrived on Netflix on 1 February 2013 in the service's available territories, including the United States.

cards.heading: A Washington adaptation
cards.text: The 2013 American House of Cards relocates an earlier British political drama to Washington. Kevin Spacey and Robin Wright play Frank and Claire Underwood, whose ambitions turn their marriage into a working political partnership. Developed by Beau Willimon, with David Fincher directing the opening episodes, its entire thirteen-episode first season arrived on Netflix on 1 February 2013 in the service's available territories, including the United States.

cards.heading: The audience inside a calculation
cards.text: Frank's work in Congress gives him influence over decisions that remain largely out of public view. A withheld promise becomes the starting point for a campaign of manipulation involving colleagues, journalists and staff. His direct addresses to the camera invite the audience into his calculations while other characters must judge him through what he chooses to show. Claire's own organisation and ambitions give the partnership a second centre, with cooperation and competition repeatedly occupying the same room.

cards.heading: A whole season available at launch
cards.text: Releasing a complete season at once changed the immediate rhythm of access: viewers could move directly to the next chapter instead of waiting for a weekly slot. Netflix's launch announcement treated the season as a continuous narrative, and the production's controlled spaces and accumulating schemes supported that form of viewing. The result became a prominent early example of a streaming service presenting an expensive original drama through a full-season release.

main.title: Random Access Memories
main.summary: Random Access Memories is the fourth and final studio album by the French electronic music duo Daft Punk.

cards.heading: Random Access Memories
cards.text:
Random Access Memories is the fourth and final studio album by the French electronic music duo Daft Punk. It was released on 17 May 2013 through Columbia Records. The album pays tribute to late 1970s and early 1980s American music, particularly from Los Angeles. This theme is reflected in the packaging and promotional campaign, which included billboards, television advertisements and a web series. Recording sessions took place from 2008 to 2012 at Henson, Conway and Capitol Studios in California, Electric Lady Studios in New York City, and Gang Recording Studio in Paris, France.

Following the minimal production of their previous album, Human After All (2005), Daft Punk recruited session musicians with the help of Chris Caswell to perform live instrumentation and limited the use of electronic instruments to drum machines, a custom-built modular synthesizer and vintage vocoders. It combines disco, progressive rock and pop, with contributions by Paul Jackson Jr., Giorgio Moroder, Chilly Gonzales, Julian Casablancas, Paul Williams, Caswell, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers, Todd Edwards, Panda Bear and DJ Falcon.

main.title: Edward Snowden: the surveillance disclosures
main.summary: Edward Snowden's disclosures in June 2013 exposed the scale of global government surveillance programmes.

cards.heading: Edward Snowden: the surveillance disclosures
cards.text: Edward Snowden's disclosures in June 2013 exposed the scale of global government surveillance programmes. A former intelligence contractor, he supplied classified documents to journalists after travelling to Hong Kong. The material described programmes operated by the NSA and the Five Eyes alliance, with cooperation from telecommunications companies and European governments. Reports by journalists including Glenn Greenwald and Laura Poitras brought the information to a wide public. The revelations prompted debate over national security and individual privacy, making hidden systems for collecting communications a subject of international public scrutiny.

main.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
main.subtitle: The company reaches the mountain and its sleeping dragon
main.summary: The Desolation of Smaug sends Bilbo and the dwarves through Mirkwood towards the Lonely Mountain. Spiders, imprisonment in the elves' kingdom and an escape in barrels turn the journey into a series of increasingly exposed encounters. Lake-town then introduces people living in the shadow of the lost kingdom, including Bard, played by Luke Evans. Reaching Erebor brings the expedition to its original destination, but recovering the treasure means waking the creature that guards it. The second film opened commercially in the United States on 13 December 2013.

cards.heading: Through the forest to Erebor

cards.heading: A dragon with a voice
cards.text: Benedict Cumberbatch supplied Smaug's voice and performance capture, giving the dragon a watchful, taunting presence as Bilbo moves through the hoard. Weta Digital built the creature alongside extensive digital settings for Erebor and Lake-town. Gold becomes both the setting of their confrontation and something the dragon can move through, disturb and use to expose the intruder. Jackson keeps the danger tied to Bilbo's attempts to hide and speak his way out. The encounter ends by carrying its consequences beyond the mountain, towards the people whose homes stand below it.
